title: Move origin_country onto dim_brand; drop sparse dim_origin_country
body:
## Summary

Drops `marts.dim_origin_country` and replaces it with a hardcoded brand → origin mapping baked into `marts.dim_brand`. hatla2ee used-car detail pages don't carry an Origin Country field (confirmed during PR #5 testing), so the dimension was effectively sentinel-only and had no analytical value.

**Changes:**
- `marts.dim_brand` gains an `origin_country` column (`text`, `not_null`), populated by a `CASE` expression keyed off the cleaned brand. Covers ~100 brands from the production scrape list. Brands we couldn't confidently classify (`Kyc`, `Rox`, `Sandstorm`, `Other`) and the `(Unknown)` sentinel fall through to `(Unknown)`.
- **Edge calls per user decision:**
  - `Mg` → `China` (current SAIC owner — not UK heritage)
  - `Speranza` → `South Korea` (Daewoo-licensed)
  - `Mini`, `Lotus`, `Volvo` → kept on heritage country (UK / UK / Sweden); ownership changes weren't a strong signal here.
- Deleted `bruin_pipeline/assets/dimensions/dim_origin_country.sql`.
- Removed `origin_country` from `staging.cars` (YAML column + SELECT projection).
- Removed `origin_country_id` from `marts.fact_car_listings` (column + FK check + `depends:` entry + LEFT JOIN).
- Updated `scripts/seed_raw_cars.py`: row 1009 brand `chevy` → `chevrolet` so the seed matches the spider's canonical output and exercises `Chevrolet → USA`.

**Out of scope (intentional):** `raw.cars.origin_country` and the spider's `OriginCountry` field stay in place. They're cheap and harmless, and on the rare dealer/newer listing where hatla2ee does populate that field, the data still lands in `raw`. `assembly_country` / `dim_assembly_country` is also unchanged.

**Verified end-to-end on a clean stack** (`make clean && make up && make seed-raw && make full-refresh`):
- `bruin-validate`: 11 assets validated
- `make full-refresh`: **11 succeeded / 58 quality checks succeeded** (was 12/62 — `−1` asset and `−4` checks for the dropped dim)
- Spot-checks against `marts.dim_brand`:
  - `Bmw → Germany`, `Mercedes → Germany`
  - `Honda → Japan`, `Nissan → Japan`, `Toyota → Japan`
  - `Hyundai → South Korea`, `Kia → South Korea`
  - `Chevrolet → USA`
  - `(Unknown)` sentinel and the `Unknown` real listing both → `(Unknown)` origin
- Idempotent on re-run.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] **Spot-check the brand → origin mapping** in `bruin_pipeline/assets/dimensions/dim_brand.sql` for any brand you specifically care about — there are ~100 entries and a wrong country is the most likely class of bug here.
- [ ] **Confirm Mg/Speranza calls are still what you want** (Mg → China, Speranza → South Korea). If you change your mind later, it's a one-line `CASE` edit.
- [ ] **Run `make clean && make up && make seed-raw && make full-refresh` locally** — should report `11 succeeded / 58 quality checks succeeded`.
- [ ] **In pgAdmin, confirm `marts.fact_car_listings` no longer has `origin_country_id`** and that `marts.dim_brand` now has `origin_country`. A handy join: `SELECT b.brand, b.origin_country, COUNT(*) FROM marts.fact_car_listings f JOIN marts.dim_brand b USING (brand_id) GROUP BY b.brand, b.origin_country ORDER BY 3 DESC;`

### Notes

- **Migration impact:** existing prod databases that ran the previous schema will still have the old `marts.dim_origin_country` table and the old `fact_car_listings.origin_country_id` column. Bruin's `materialization: type: table` rebuilds the fact table from scratch on each run, so the old `origin_country_id` column will disappear automatically once `make full-refresh` runs against an upgraded copy of this code. The orphaned `marts.dim_origin_country` table needs a manual `DROP TABLE marts.dim_origin_country;` (Bruin doesn't auto-drop deleted assets).
- **Unmapped brands** are silently routed to `(Unknown)` rather than failing a check — if hatla2ee starts surfacing a new brand (e.g. another Chinese EV) it'll show up in dashboards as Origin = `(Unknown)` until someone adds a `WHEN` clause. A monitoring query: `SELECT brand FROM marts.dim_brand WHERE origin_country = '(Unknown)' AND brand <> '(Unknown)';`

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/093373a40552411898d467c538c6775c
Requested by: @Moaaz-Elhaiys

## Summary by Sourcery

Consolidate car origin country handling by deriving origin directly on the brand dimension and removing the sparse origin-country dimension from the pipeline.

Enhancements:
- Add a hardcoded brand-to-origin_country mapping to marts.dim_brand, including an explicit '(Unknown)' brand row for unmapped cases.
- Stop projecting origin_country in staging.cars, relying instead on the derived brand-level origin mapping.
- Remove origin_country_id usage from marts.fact_car_listings to simplify the fact schema and dependency graph.

Tests:
- Adjust seed_raw_cars sample data so brand canonicalization correctly exercises the Chevrolet-to-USA mapping.

Chores:
- Delete the obsolete marts.dim_origin_country dimension asset from the project.
